provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: exhaustion over all 66 pairs of 1-qutrit stabilizer states

notes: Settles chi(|T3>) = 3 with the rank-3 upper bound. On one qutrit there are only 12 stabilizer states, so the rank-2 question is 66 pairs and is decided by exhaustion rather than by the Galois argument, which reaches the same bound at every m but is not yet formalized. The exclusion is numerical and rests on a margin: the closest any two candidate directions come to parallel is 0.956 against a threshold of 1 - 1e-6, so no rounding at the 1e-15 level of these inputs can close the gap. The Strange state at m=1 has a known rank-2 decomposition, which the same code finds as a positive control.
